references.text: Parallel text describing the original instructions for the hangings of the court, including the fifteen-cubit-long hangings on both sides of the gate with three pillars and three bases.
Describes the hangings on one side of the gate, while verse 15 describes the other side with identical measurements—fifteen cubits with three pillars and three bases.
Provides context for the court's structure with pillars and bases made of bronze, which are the same construction elements mentioned in this verse.
Describes the gate of the court that was placed between the two sides of hangings mentioned in verses 14–15, providing context for the entire entrance structure.
This reference confirms that the actual execution of the gate followed God's exact specifications given earlier.
This reference shows the original instruction that was followed precisely in the building description.
This verse completes the picture of the gate by describing the curtain itself hanging between the pillars.
